info.name: DORMEASE — boarding house API
info.description:
Run order matters for the folder named "Guest to tenant lifecycle"; every other folder stands on its own.

Setup: start MySQL 8, run `cd backend && npm run db:setup` (it applies database/schema/*.sql then database/seed/*.sql in order), then `npm start`.

The seeded demo password for all three accounts is DormEase#2026. These accounts exist only for the demo database — never keep them in production.

Collection-level auth is `Bearer {{token}}`, so a request only needs a login to have happened first. Public requests ignore the header. Each login request overwrites {{token}} with its own session, which is how the negative checks switch roles.

`{{invitationToken}}` is filled by the approve step and is single-use: running "Accept invitation" twice gives 404 the second time, which is the intended behaviour.

item.name: 03 Guest to tenant lifecycle
item.description: Run in order. It is the whole purpose of the system: a stranger asks for a room, staff approve it, and only that approval creates the tenant, the lease and the single-use invitation. Requires a token from Login as landlord or Login as staff for the first two requests.
